name: flee_script
instruction: Skeletons should run away from the hero when their health drops below 3.
responses:
{
  "summary": "Make skeletons flee when their health drops below 3 by replacing their script with one that also handles fleeing.",
  "operations": [
    {
      "op": "command",
      "name": "script.write",
      "args": {
        "path": "scripts/enemy_flee.lua",
        "source": "-- enemy_flee.lua: a melee enemy that flees when hurt.
-- Chasing is handled by the entity's Follow component; this script decides
-- when to swing and when to flee.

properties = {
    swing_range = 1.1, -- cells; a bit more than MeleeAttack.reach
    flee_threshold = 3, -- flee when health drops below this
    flee_speed = 3.0,  -- cells per second
    taunt = "",       -- a sound to play when it first spots the player
}

local spotted = false
local normal_speed = nil

function update(dt)
    local target, distance = find_nearest("Player")
    if not target then
        return
    end
    if not spotted and distance < get_field(self_id(), "Follow", "range") then
        spotted = true
        if properties.taunt ~= "" then
            play_sound(properties.taunt)
        end
    end
    local current_hp = get_health()
    if current_hp < properties.flee_threshold then
        -- Flee: turn Follow off and run away
        if normal_speed == nil then
            normal_speed = get_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed")
        end
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed", properties.flee_speed)
        local tx, ty = position_of(target)
        local x, y = get_position()
        move_toward(x + (x - tx), y + (y - ty), properties.flee_speed)
    else
        -- Chase: restore Follow and swing if close enough
        if normal_speed ~= nil then
            set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed", normal_speed)
            normal_speed = nil
        end
        if distance < properties.swing_range then
            attack_toward(target)
        end
    end
end
